# Advisories govulncheck reports as reachable that the CI gate accepts.
#
# One entry per line: the advisory ID, then why PAMv1 is not affected and
# where the proof lives (a test that fails on the vulnerable code, or the
# reasoning). An entry is a claim, not a snooze: it must be true of the
# dependency version go.mod pins today. CI warns once an entry is no longer
# reported (the database caught up, or the code no longer reaches it), and the
# entry is then removed. Every other reachable advisory still fails the build.

GO-2026-6909  crewjam/saml v0.5.2 fixes both flaws (crewjam/saml#679, #675); the record lists no fixed version yet (golang/vulndb#6909, CL 861981). Proof: internal/saml TestAdvisoryGO20266909, which fails on v0.5.1. Phase 287.
